short: Investigation on mechanical properties and creep behavior of
title: Investigation on mechanical properties and creep behavior of stir cast AZ91-SiCp composites

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: AZ91 castings lose strength and creep resistance above 150 C, which keeps Mg out of hot powertrain parts. Adding SiC particles should raise the strength and the creep resistance of the AZ91 matrix.
states.detail: Absorbed: t1 (HYP/need), t2 (HYP/hypothesis), t3 (DES/base_system), t4 (DES/modification), t5 (DES/variable_sweep), t6 (PRC/forming)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: SiCp are spread through the matrix, with clustering and banding that grow with loading. Matrix grain size falls from 65 um to 34 um at 5 wt% and 22 um at 10 wt%, and barely changes above that.
states.detail: Absorbed: t7 (STR/microstructure/distribution), t8 (STR/microstructure/feature_size), t9 (STR/interface). Premises: SiC wets Mg well and the Al in AZ91 further improves the wettability of SiCp

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Tensile yield strength rises monotonically from 93 MPa to 143 MPa over 0-25 wt% SiCp. Ultimate compressive strength rises monotonically from about 310 MPa to 363 MPa.
states.detail: Absorbed: t10 (PRP/value), t11 (PRP/value), t12 (PRP/value), t13 (PRP/behavior_class), t14 (MEC/pathway), t15 (PRP/value), t16 (PRP/diagnostic), t17 (MEC/identification). Premises: SiC has a compressive strength of 3900 MPa against 310 MPa for the base alloy; The strengthening mechanisms in Mg matrix composites are particle strengthening, work hardening, load transfer and matrix grain refinement; Li and Langdon's threshold-stress method: extrapolate each creep curve to 1e-10 /s to read the threshold stress, then replot against the effective stress; A true stress exponent near 5 indicates dislocation climb controlled by lattice diffusion

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Composites with 15 wt% SiCp and above resist creep at 175 C under 80-120 MPa

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Stir-cast AZ91-SiCp gains yield and compressive strength and creep resistance through grain refinement, dislocation blocking and a particle threshold stress

nodes.title: MICRO, F1, F2
nodes.head: Dark SiCp fill the field ever more densely from 5 to 25 wt%, and from 15 wt% upward they gather into bands and clusters separated by particle-free matrix. At low magnification the bright SiCp of the 20 wt% composite cover the whole field with no large bare regions
nodes.solves: SiCp are spread through the matrix, with clustering and banding that grow with loading
nodes.note: all six panels carry 200 um bars (OCR cue); the banding is strongest in the 25 wt% panel, where the clusters line up along one direction the burnt-in banner reads x150 with a 100 um bar; the OCR cue line renders that bar as '108Mm'

nodes.title: MICRO, F1

nodes.solves: Matrix grain size falls from 65 um to 34 um at 5 wt% and 22 um at 10 wt%, and barely changes above that

Judge check of F1a/F1c: F1a resolves the boundary network cleanly, while F1c keeps only faint discontinuous bright lines between the dark particles, enough to suggest where boundaries lie but not to size grains

nodes.title: MICRO, F2
nodes.head: At high magnification the faceted SiC particles sit against the matrix with no visible reaction layer or precipitate band at their edges
nodes.solves: The Mg/SiCp interface is clean and free of reaction products, with the particles well bonded to the matrix
nodes.note: the banner reads x1500 with a 10 um bar, so a sub-micron reaction layer could not be resolved either way; the matrix around the particles is rough and partly pulled away, so this is not a polished cross-section of the interface

nodes.title: evidence, F7
nodes.head: Apparent stress exponents printed in the legend: 7.2, 7.4, 7.7, 8.5, 8.4 and 8.9 for 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 wt%. Replotted against effective stress the six series collapse onto nearly one line with true exponents 5.4, 5.5, 5.6, 5.8, 5.6 and 5.7.

nodes.op: collapse by normalization, cross check consistency, fit model
nodes.note: values read from the panel legend; each is the slope of a three-point log-log fit the merge of the six lines is the evidence; values read from the panel legend, and the threshold stresses that set the abscissa are tabulated rather than plotted audit node: the figure shows the discrepancy with the text, which reads a rise from 7.2 to 8.9 with SiCp content
